fish.name: Glassfin
fish.description: A bright little pond fish. Cook with a lanterncap aboard your ship.

stew.name: Harbor chowder
stew.description: Glassfin, lanterncaps and a pinch of home. Restores stamina. Neri would love a bowl.

seed.name: Cinderbloom seed
seed.description: A hardy seed from Orren’s listening garden. Ivo will want to study it.

moonfruit.name: Sunplum
moonfruit.description: A tart golden fruit from Orren. Good for tea, or a long walk.

ration.name: Orchard trailcake
ration.description: Oat, honeyfruit, and a little homesickness. Restores all stamina and grants 90 seconds of easy running.

battery.name: Field cell
battery.description: A sturdy power cell. Survey equipment never seems to have enough of these.

parts.name: Repair fittings
parts.description: Universal couplings for very non-universal spacecraft. Useful at the ship workbench.

module.name: Echo module
module.description: Recovered from the woodland beacon. It carries a pulse identical to your ship’s fault.

glowcap.name: Lanterncap
glowcap.description: A soft blue mushroom. The gills glow in time with the old survey towers.

mineral.name: Cloud quartz
mineral.description: Milky crystal with a faint blue core. Oren buys it for the settlement’s filters.

scrap.name: Salvaged alloy
scrap.description: Clean scrap from a time when everything had sharp corners. Tradable with Oren.

archive.name: Surveyor’s keepsake
archive.description: A scratched recording wafer. Someone wanted the next visitor to remember this place.

tea.name: Moonmint tea
tea.description: A little warmth for the road. Restores stamina and grants 90 seconds of easy running.
